title: Burak Çetin
text: Excited to share that my PR for RotorPy support has been merged into PX4! title: MAXXIS Europe
text: Building a great tire takes time. The MAXXPLORE took over a year. Not because it's complicated, but because getting the balance right is hard. Mileage, wet grip, stability. title: MathWorks
text: 🎓 MATLAB DAY at Anurag University - A Day of Learning, Innovation & Engineering Excellence! We are pleased to share that MATLAB DAY at Anurag University was successfully conducted by the ARKANCE Education Team, with an enthusiastic response from 200+ students and faculty members across core engineering disciplines. The full-day technical program provided participants with valuable insights into the MathWorks Campus-Wide License, MATLAB & Simulink, academic learning resources, and applications across engineering domains. ✨ Key highlights included: • Introduction to MATLAB, Simulink & Campus-Wide License • Live technical demonstrations across engineering applications • MATLAB Academic Online Training & self-learning resources • Software installation and access guidance • Interactive Q&A with students and faculty A special thanks to our ARKANCE team - P Chandhana , uday Kumar , Naresh Babu , and Francis Arokia Swamy - for successfully planning and delivering the program. We sincerely thank Ajay Talluri and Loy Sabson Fernandes from MathWorks for their continued support and guidance. Together, MathWorks, Anurag University & ARKANCE continue to empower the next generation of engineers with industry-relevant tools, knowledge, and learning opportunities. #MATLABDay #MATLAB #Simulink #MathWorks #AnuragUniversity #ARKANCE #EngineeringEducation #EngineeringStudents #TechnicalEducation #Innovation #AcademicTechnology #ARKANCEIndia

title: Relativity Space
text: Last week in true Relativity Space fashion we said Good Luck, Have Fun to our Additive Development interns as they head back to school. This was my first time as a formal intern manager, and I was incredibly impressed with how big of an impact our interns made in such a short time. I learned a lot about the balance of leadership and technical work, making sure that we are achieving our milestones while building a team that works well together and plays to the strengths of each individual. Cinco Murchison I really enjoyed working with you this summer, thank you for your eagerness to learn and the lasting contributions you have made to our manufacturing processes. It always feels like our interns leave us before we are ready, and we hope this is not goodbye but see you later. Whether that’s here at Relativity next year or our paths crossing further down the road, we are proud of you and are cheering you on from the sidelines in all of your academic and professional endeavors!

title: Traditional aerial firefighting is broken. Here is how I propose to fix it. Dropping water from ultra-low altitudes endangers flight crews and frequently loses efficiency due to fl
text: Traditional aerial firefighting is broken. Here is how I propose to fix it. Dropping water from ultra-low altitudes endangers flight crews and frequently loses efficiency due to fluid evaporation before reaching the fire perimeter. I have developed a method for high-altitude structured water release from 150 meters, integrated with automatic navigation systems. Key Technical Advantages: 📍 High Precision: Phased, targeted agent distribution along active fire edges — even at night and under light smoke conditions. 🛡 Crew Safety: Flight operations occur at a safe altitude, well above extreme thermal updrafts and hazardous terrain. 🌲 Maximum Efficiency: Optimized drop physics maximize fluid volume reaching the ground. Physics works the same everywhere, making this technology universally applicable. Given the urgency of the global fire crisis, I am currently preparing this solution for deployment in North America (Canada & US) with a vision for global implementation. I'm looking for strategic R&D partners, grant co-applicants, and venture investors to help scale development. I also have a portfolio of over ten engineering solutions focused on enhancing fire suppression in wildland and complex urban environments. 📄 Full technical layout and details are in the attached document below.
